proofs.text: Sign `RULE-1` on a branch called `side`; verify the signature is not an ancestor of `main`, then fast-forward `main` onto `side` and verify it is

reasons: PROOF-29 missing_trigger: Nothing runs before the assertion, so the proof reads an artifact that exists whether or not the code is right.
rule_text: A signature committed on a side branch is not on the protected branch until that branch merges

tests.body:
def test_a_signature_on_a_side_branch_is_not_on_the_protected_branch(
            self, proved):
        signing_key(proved.root)
        git(proved.root, 'checkout', '-q', '-b', 'side')
        sign_module.main(['login', 'RULE-1', '--project-root', proved.root])
        path = proved.load()[('login', 'RULE-1')][0]['path']
        assert not purlin_signatures.is_ancestor(proved.root, path, 'main')
        git(proved.root, 'checkout', '-q', 'main')
        git(proved.root, 'merge', '-q', '--ff-only', 'side')
        assert purlin_signatures.is_ancestor(proved.root, path, 'main')
